customSections.label: Which Madison County School Calendar Is This?
customSections.content: This page covers the Madison County School System (MCSS) calendar in Alabama. Huntsville City Schools and Madison City Schools are separate school systems with their own calendars. For school-specific events or dismissal times, check your child's school.

customSections.label: How We Counted 180 MCSS Instructional Days
customSections.content: The district PDF does not list a total number of instructional days. Counting the color-coded school-day grid gives 180 instructional days: 86 in the first semester and 94 in the second. The count includes both E-Learning/Collaboration Days and both half-days, while excluding staff-only dates, breaks, holidays and the April 30 Weather Day closure.

calendarFaqs.q: Are MCSS E-Learning / Collaboration Days days off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. September 4, 2026 and February 12, 2027 count as instructional days, not days off. Families should follow district or school instructions for those dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When do MCSS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Student Winter Break runs through Monday, January 4, 2027. January 4 is also a staff Work Day, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Is April 30, 2027 a scheduled school closure or a make-up day?
calendarFaqs.a: MCSS lists April 30 as a scheduled Weather Day when the school system is closed. The approved calendar does not show it as a possible make-up day held in reserve.

calendarFaqs.q: What time do MCSS students dismiss on half-days?
calendarFaqs.a: MCSS identifies December 18 and May 26 as student half-days, but the district calendar does not list a districtwide dismissal time. Check with your school for its schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Does MCSS provide a separate Spanish 2026–27 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: The Spanish-labeled link currently opens the same English PDF. This page therefore does not list it as a separate Spanish download.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 23, 2026, against the complete one-page MCSS calendar approved June 12, 2025. The PDF reviewed for this page matches MCSS's current official file byte-for-byte.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we reviewed the MCSS calendar
sourceReviewDetails: Checked every dated item, all 12 month grids, the color legend, report-card table, employee break ranges and board-approval line on the one-page PDF.
The PDF we reviewed is byte-for-byte identical to the file currently linked by MCSS (SHA-256: c4a33eb7b62168095af383cbc64c8caf5a5b683bce93a94bfb7bc6a29c71bcc6).
Counted 86 first-semester and 94 second-semester instructional days from the color-coded grid, for 180 total. The count includes the two E-Learning days and two half-days.
Confirmed from the month grid that December 18 and May 26 are student half-days even though the central dated list only names May 26 as the last student day.
Kept the student break ranges separate from the shorter teacher, 212-plus-day and 240-day employee ranges printed on the PDF.
The Spanish-labeled calendar entry is identical to the English PDF URL and opens the same English file, so no separate Spanish download is displayed.
sourceNextReviewText: We review this page again if MCSS revises the academic calendar, changes the April 30 Weather Day designation, or publishes a separate Spanish calendar.
